# CheckYourself

> Local-first production-readiness audit for AI-built apps: read-only checks, 0–100 score, guided fixes.

## What it is
A folder-based ICM tool + Python CLI + stdio MCP server that audits an AI-built app before launch: read-only review, evidence-based 0–100 score, ranked fixes, learning plan.

## Install / use
Drop the folder into your project, or run `python3 tools/checkyourself.py mcp` as an MCP server.

## Links
- Repository: https://github.com/KyaniteLabs/checkyourself
